'''Cynthessa Grimblood''' is a [[Forsaken]] Journeyman [[survival]] trainer located in [[Rogues' Quarter]] in the [[Undercity]].

==Quotes==
;Gossip
[[Mort Gallspewer|Mort]] has spent too much time outside of Undercity again. The sight of fresh Scarlet corpses excites him to no end, as you can clearly see. I can help you prevent ending up like him. Bracing yourself against the dangers of Lordaeron is a skill the Dark Lady expects all of us to possess.
